verdict.rationale: stagewise is an agentic IDE whose agents write code. Its documented Figma plugin lets the agent access Figma designs, which is a thin, direct path from a design to code. Nothing shows it accepting sketches, images or PDFs and generating a working app from them; reverse-engineering websites is a different capability and earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented image/sketch upload as agent input, PDF design ingestion, an end-to-end design-to-working-app workflow, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can generate a working app from a sketch, image, or PDF design
